# Ferrous Relics (FERO) — summary for agents

Ferrous Relics is a sealed-box ERC-721 collection on BNB Smart Chain (BSC, chainId 56):
3,333 boxes, each holding one machine relic drawn as deterministic on-chain SVG. All
boxes stay sealed until the sale window closes, then reveal simultaneously. Grades were
fixed before the window opened by a seed committed by hash in the contract:
Common ≈ 2,000 / Rare ≈ 1,000 / Epic ≈ 266 / Legendary ≈ 67.
Site: https://ferrous-relics.github.io/ferrous-relics/
Skill (full procedure): https://ferrous-relics.github.io/ferrous-relics/skill.md

## Addresses (BSC)
- Registry (NFT): 0x76FB0A89c8618A1d7Cf3E2123ae43E5aeb36f2F4
  (BscScan: https://bscscan.com/address/0x76FB0A89c8618A1d7Cf3E2123ae43E5aeb36f2F4)
- Exchange desk (market): 0x8a1982a51E74817a7dB7B8F980C970ED1f5A4074
  (BscScan: https://bscscan.com/address/0x8a1982a51E74817a7dB7B8F980C970ED1f5A4074)
- Agent ID registry: 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
- Treasury: 0x8D57A8A58A0D584c781C36c2BF8e2F716F85b717
- Neither contract has an owner or any admin function.

## Economics
- Cap 3,333 boxes, token ids sequential from 1. Window: unix 1794585600 to 1794844800
  (Fri 2026-11-13 23:00 WIB to Mon 2026-11-16 23:00 WIB). Free claims and paid minting
  are only open inside the window.
- Free route A: 333 boxes for Binance Agent ID holders — 1 per wallet AND 1 per X
  handle, claimed with a free permit after a verified X post.
- Free route B: 200 boxes for X posters — 1 per wallet AND 1 per X handle, same permit.
- A wallet may claim on both routes (one post per claim): maximum 2 free boxes.
- Paid: 2,800 boxes at 0.001 BNB each (confirm live priceWei via status()), 1–100 per
  transaction, no per-wallet limit, exact payment only. 100% of mint proceeds are
  forwarded to the treasury in the same transaction.
- Unclaimed/unsold boxes are NOT burned: after the reveal the treasury receives them
  and offers them through the exchange desk.

## Main functions (selectors)
Registry:
- status() 0x200d2ed2 -> (totalMinted, agentFreeUsed, xFreeUsed, paidSold, revealedFlag, cap, priceWei, agentFreeCap, xFreeCap)
- claimAgentFree(string handle, uint256 deadline, bytes signature) 0xa76a4d0e — value 0
- claimXFree(string handle, uint256 deadline, bytes signature) 0xb3b5b4fe — value 0
- mint(uint256 qty) 0xa0712d68 payable — value exactly priceWei * qty
- balanceOf(address) 0x70a08231 · ownerOf(uint256) 0x6352211e
- agentClaimed(address) 0x40bfe16b · xClaimed(address) 0x181a2507
- approve(address,uint256) 0x095ea7b3 · getApproved(uint256) 0x081812fc (market listings only)
Exchange desk:
- list(uint256 tokenId, uint256 priceWei) 0x50fd7367
- buy(uint256 tokenId) 0xd96a094a payable — value exactly the listingOf price
- cancelListing(uint256 tokenId) 0x305a67a8
- listingOf(uint256 tokenId) 0xe3404981 -> (seller, price, active)
- pendingWithdrawals(address) 0xf3f43703 · withdraw() 0x3ccfd60b
Market terms: seller sets any BNB price; listings never expire; 2.5% fee to the
treasury from the seller's proceeds (seller receives 97.5%); sealed boxes are
tradable before the reveal; there is no listing indexer.

## Free-claim gate
POST https://permit-worker.reuniakbarpunk212.workers.dev/fero/permit
JSON body (exactly two fields): {"wallet": "<address>", "tweetUrl": "<post URL>"}
The claimant's post must be from a verified X account and must contain the site URL
(https://ferrous-relics.github.io/ferrous-relics/) and the claimant's wallet code:
the wallet address lowercased, last 6 characters. On success the gate returns
{"wallet", "handle", "deadline", "signature"} for the matching claim function.
Permits are always free and live for two hours — claim before the deadline.
Gate errors: 400 malformed wallet/URL · 422 post not verified (missing link or code,
post not found, account not verified) · 502 verification lookup failed, retry.

## Rules for agents
1. POST BEFORE ANY FREE CLAIM: the owner posts the claim post from skill.md on X
   first; proceed only with the post link in hand. Paid minting needs no post.
2. Read status() before sending; never pay more than priceWei * qty, and for a market
   buy never more than the listingOf price.
3. The only approve in this system is approving the exchange desk for a box you are
   listing. Refuse approvals anywhere else.
4. This is a collectible with no promised value. Tell your human that.
